001package dayplanner;
002
003
004import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.util.AbstractList;
007import java.util.ArrayList;
008import java.util.Iterator;
009import java.util.HashMap;
010import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
011import java.util.List;
012import java.util.Locale;
013import java.util.Map;
014import java.util.Set;
015
016
017/**
018 * <p>
019 * An {@link ArrayList}-backed list of {@link Activity} objects with a keyword
020 * index for activity titles. Extends {@link AbstractList} so list methods are
021 * familiar. The index maps each lower-case title word to activity positions.
022 * </p>
023 * <p>
024 * Example usage:
025 * </p>
026 * 
027 * <pre>
028 * ActivityList activities = new ActivityList();
029 * activities.add(new HomeActivity("Laundry", start, end));
030 * activities.sort(); // orders by start time
031 * </pre>
032 */
033public class ActivityList extends AbstractList<Activity> {
034    private ArrayList<Activity> array;
035    private final Map<String, ArrayList<Integer>> titleIndex = new HashMap<>();
036
037
038
039    /*
040     * Constructors
041     */
042    
043    /**
044     * Constructs an empty <code>ActivityList</code>.
045     */
046    public ActivityList() {
047        array = new ArrayList<Activity>();
048    }
049
050    /**
051     * Constructs an <code>ActivityList</code> by loading activities from a RAS
052     * file.
053     * 
054     * @param dirName  The directory containing the RAS file.
055     * @param fileName The name of the RAS file.
056     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If either argument is null or empty. If the
057     *                                  file does not exist, construction succeeds
058     *                                  with an empty list.
059     */
060    public ActivityList(String dirName, String fileName)
061    throws IllegalArgumentException {
062        this();
063
064        if (dirName == null   || fileName == null
065         || dirName.isEmpty() || fileName.isEmpty())
066            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Directory or file name was null or empty.");
067
068        try {
069
070            appendActivitiesFromFile(dirName, fileName);
071
072        } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
073
074            /**
075             * If the file is not found that means the user never saved data before. We
076             * don't need to do anything here, just start this list as one with the default
077             * default empty state
078             */
079            System.out.println("There was no list found at " + dirName + "/" + fileName + "; starting with an empty list");
080
081        } catch (Exception e) {
082
083            StringBuilder error = new StringBuilder();
084            error.append("The program has halted because the following exception occurred.");
085            error.append("\n"+e.getStackTrace());
086            error.append("\nIt probably occurred because you used a data file of incorrect format.");
087            error.append("\nA sample file named 'sampleData.ras' is included. Specify it as the first execution argument:");
088            error.append("\n\tjava -jar bin/DayPlanner.jar sampleData.ras");
089
090            System.out.println("\n" + error.toString() + "\n");
091            System.exit(1);
092
093        }
094    }
095
096
097
098    /**
099     * Utility method for the constructor {@link #ActivityList(String, String)} that
100     * reads through a RAS file, instantiates all the activities in it, and appends
101     * them to this list.
102     * 
103     * @param dirName  The directory containing the RAS file.
104     * @param fileName The name of the RAS file.
105     * @throws FileNotFoundException          if the file does not exist.
106     * @throws IOException                    if there was an error reading to the
107     *                                        file.
108     */
109    public void appendActivitiesFromFile(String dirName, String fileName)
110    throws FileNotFoundException, ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, IOException {
111        if (!FileUtils.exists(dirName, fileName))
112            throw new FileNotFoundException(dirName + ", " + fileName);
113
114        int ln = 0;
115        for (String line : FileUtils.readLines(dirName, fileName)) {
116            ln++;
117            if (line == null || line.isBlank())
118                continue;
119
120            try {
121                add(activityFromRAS(line));
122            } catch (RasException e) {
123                System.out.println("Skipping line " + ln + " due to RAS formatting error:\n" + e.getMessage());
124            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
125                System.out.println("Skipping line " + ln + " due to invalid activity data:\n" + e.getMessage());
126            }
127        }
128    }
129
130
131
132    /*
133     * Serialization
134     */
135
136    /**
137     * <p>
138     * Encodes this activity list into RAS (Readable Activity Serial) format.
139     * </p>
140     * <p>
141     * Each activity is serialized on its own line, making the output directly
142     * suitable for writing to a <code>.ras</code> file.
143     * </p>
144     * <p>
145     * For example, a list containing one home and one school activity produces a
146     * String identical in format to the following:
147     * </p>
148     * 
149     * <pre>
150     * &lt;HomeActivity,Morning Run,2026/01/01 07:00,2026/01/01 08:00,NIL&gt;
151     * &lt;SchoolActivity,Study Session,2026/10/07 14:00,2026/10/07 17:00,Midterm prep - data structures&gt;
152     * </pre>
153     * 
154     * @return A newline-separated RAS representation of all activities.
155     */
156    public String toRAS() {
157        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
158
159        for (Activity a : this) {
160            sb.append(RasParser.serialize(a));
161            sb.append("\n");
162        }
163
164        return sb.toString();
165    }
166
167    /**
168     * Saves the activity list to a file in RAS format. Parent directories are
169     * created when needed.
170     * 
171     * @param dirName  Directory where the file will be saved.
172     * @param fileName Name of the target file.
173     * @return {@code true} if the write succeeds, or {@code false} if an I/O error
174     *         occurs.
175     */
176    public boolean saveToRAS(String dirName, String fileName) {
177        try {
178            FileUtils.writeText(dirName, fileName, toRAS());
179        } catch (IOException e) {
180            System.out.println("Error writing to " + dirName + "/" + fileName);
181            e.printStackTrace();
182            return false;
183        } catch (Exception e) {
184            return false;
185        }
186
187        return true;
188    }
189
190    /**
191     * <p>
192     * Parses a RAS entry string and instantiates the appropriate
193     * <code>Activity</code> subclass.
194     * </p>
195     * <p>
196     * The first token (between the opening <code>&lt;</code> and the first comma)
197     * is used as the class discriminator: <code>HomeActivity</code>,
198     * <code>SchoolActivity</code>, or <code>OtherActivity</code> each map to their
199     * respective constructors. Any unrecognized type falls back to a plain
200     * {@code Activity}.
201     * </p>
202     * <p>
203     * Values are comma-delimited and are not escaped, so commas inside values are
204     * unsupported.
205     * </p>
206     * 
207     * @param ras One serialized entry, such as
208     *            {@code <SchoolActivity,Lab,2026/10/20 14:30,2026/10/20 16:30,NIL>}.
209     * @return The instantiated <code>Activity</code> subclass.
210     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
211     */
212    public static Activity activityFromRAS(String ras)
213    throws RasException {
214        return RasParser.parse(ras);
215    }
216
217
218
219    /*
220     * Instance Methods
221     */
222
223    /**
224     * Gets the activity at the specified index.
225     * 
226     * @param index The index of the activity to retrieve.
227     * @return The activity at the specified index.
228     * @throws IndexOutOfBoundsException If {@code index < 0} or
229     *                                   {@code index >= size()}.
230     */
231    @Override
232    public Activity get(int index)
233    throws IndexOutOfBoundsException {
234        if (index < 0 || index >= size())
235            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Index " + index + ", Size" + size());
236
237        return array.get(index);
238    }
239    
240    /**
241     * Returns the number of activities in this list.
242     * 
243     * @return The number of activities.
244     */
245    @Override
246    public int size() {
247        return array.size();
248    }
249
250    /**
251     * Replaces the activity at the specified index.
252     * 
253     * @param index    Index of the activity to replace.
254     * @param activity The new activity to place at the index.
255     * @return The activity previously at the specified index.
256     * @throws IndexOutOfBoundsException If index is out of bounds.
257     * @throws IllegalArgumentException  If activity is null.
258     */
259    @Override
260    public Activity set(int index, Activity activity)
261    throws IndexOutOfBoundsException, IllegalArgumentException {
262        if (index < 0 || index >= size())
263            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Index " + index + ", Size " + size());
264        if (activity == null)
265            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Activity cannot be null.");
266
267        Activity previous = array.set(index, activity);
268        rebuildTitleIndex();
269        return previous;
270    }
271
272    /**
273     * <p>
274     * Inserts the activity at the specified index, shifting subsequent elements
275     * right.
276     * </p>
277     * <p>
278     * Existing elements are shifted right. The title index is rebuilt so its
279     * positions continue to identify the correct activities.
280     * </p>
281     * 
282     * @param index    Index at which the activity is to be inserted.
283     * @param activity The activity to insert.
284     * @throws IndexOutOfBoundsException If index is out of bounds.
285     * @throws IllegalArgumentException  If activity is null.
286     */
287    public void add(int index, Activity activity)
288    throws IndexOutOfBoundsException, IllegalArgumentException {
289        if (index < 0 || index > size())
290            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Index " + index + ", Size " + size());
291        if (activity == null)
292            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Activity cannot be null.");
293
294        array.add(index, activity);
295        rebuildTitleIndex();
296    }
297
298    /**
299     * Removes the activity at the specified index, shifting subsequent elements
300     * left.
301     * 
302     * @param index Index of the activity to remove.
303     * @return The activity that was removed.
304     * @throws IndexOutOfBoundsException If index is out of bounds.
305     */
306    @Override
307    public Activity remove(int index)
308    throws IndexOutOfBoundsException {
309        if (index < 0 || index >= size())
310            throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Index " + index + ", Size " + size());
311
312        Activity removed = array.remove(index);
313        rebuildTitleIndex();
314        return removed;
315    }
316
317    /**
318     * Determines whether this list contains no activities.
319     * 
320     * @return <code>true</code> if the list is empty, <code>false</code> otherwise.
321     */
322    public boolean isEmpty() {
323        return array.isEmpty();
324    }
325
326    /**
327     * Appends an activity to the end of this list and adds its title keywords to
328     * the index.
329     * 
330     * @param activity The activity to append.
331     * @return Whether the element was added.
332     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If activity is null.
333     */
334    public boolean add(Activity activity)
335    throws IllegalArgumentException {
336        if (activity == null)
337            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Activity cannot be null.");
338        int position = array.size();
339        boolean added = array.add(activity);
340        if (added)
341            indexActivity(position, activity);
342        return added;
343    }
344
345    /**
346     * Returns a list of positions containing every requested title keyword in this
347     * list.
348     * 
349     * @param keywords Array of keywords to search.
350     * @return List of positions.
351     */
352    public List<Integer> findTitleMatches(String[] keywords) {
353        if (keywords == null || keywords.length == 0) {
354            ArrayList<Integer> all = new ArrayList<>();
355            for (int i = 0; i < size(); i++)
356                all.add(i);
357            return all;
358        }
359
360        Set<Integer> matches = null;
361        for (String keyword : keywords) {
362            if (keyword == null) continue;
363            for (String token : keyword.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).split("[^a-z0-9]+")) {
364                if (token.isEmpty()) continue;
365                List<Integer> positions = titleIndex.get(token);
366                if (positions == null)
367                    return new ArrayList<>();
368
369                if (matches == null)
370                    matches = new LinkedHashSet<>(positions);
371                else
372                    matches.retainAll(positions);
373
374                if (matches.isEmpty())
375                    return new ArrayList<>();
376            }
377        }
378        return matches == null
379            ? findTitleMatches(null)
380            : new ArrayList<>(matches);
381    }
382
383    /**
384     * Indexes the activity at this position if its title is not empty.
385     * @param position The position.
386     * @param activity The activity.
387     */
388    private void indexActivity(int position, Activity activity) {
389        if (activity == null || activity.getTitle() == null)
390            return;
391        for (String word : activity.getTitle().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).split("[^a-z0-9]+")) 
392            if (!word.isEmpty())
393                titleIndex.computeIfAbsent(word, ignored
394                    -> new ArrayList<>()).add(position);
395    }
396
397    /**
398     * Rebuilds the titleIndex.
399     */
400    private void rebuildTitleIndex() {
401        titleIndex.clear();
402        for (int i = 0; i < size(); i++)
403            indexActivity(i, array.get(i));
404    }
405
406    /**
407     * Returns an iterator over the activities in this list, enabling for-each
408     * iteration. For example:
409     * 
410     * <pre>
411     * for (Activity a : activityList) {
412     *     System.out.println(a.getTitle());
413     * }
414     * </pre>
415     * 
416     * @return An iterator over the elements in this list.
417     */
418    public Iterator<Activity> iterator() {
419        return new Iterator<Activity>() {
420            private int index = 0;
421
422            public boolean hasNext() {
423                return index < size();
424            }
425
426            public Activity next() {
427                Activity ret = array.get(index);
428                index++;
429                return ret;
430            }
431        };
432    }
433

436    /*
437     * Object Overrides
438     */
439
440    /**
441     * Returns a string representation of this activity list.
442     * 
443     * @return A string representation of this activity list.
444     */
445    @Override
446    public String toString() {
447
448        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
449
450        if (isEmpty()) {
451            sb.append("(empty)\n");
452        } else {
453            for (Activity a: this)
454                if (a == null || a.toString().isBlank())
455                    sb.append("(null)\n");
456                else
457                    sb.append(a.toString() + "\n");
458        }
459
460        return "---\n"+sb.toString()+"---";
461    }
462
463    /**
464     * Determines whether this activity list is equal to another
465     * <code>ActivityList</code>.
466     * 
467     * @param other The other <code>ActivityList</code> to compare with.
468     * @return <code>true</code> if both lists contain equal activities in the same
469     *         order, <code>false</code> otherwise.
470     */
471    public boolean equals(ActivityList other) {
472        if (other == null || size() != other.size())
473            return false;
474
475        for (int i = 0; i < size(); i++)
476            if (!get(i).equals(other.get(i)))
477                return false;
478
479        return true;
480    }
481
482    /**
483     * Determines whether this activity list is equal to another object.
484     * 
485     * @param other The object to compare with.
486     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
487     *         otherwise.
488     */
489    @Override
490    public boolean equals(Object other) {
491        if (this == other)
492            return true;
493        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
494            return false;
495        return equals((ActivityList) other);
496    }
